{{Quote|Their 'resistance' was laughable. We cut through their defenses like Vibroblades through cloth.|[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] Captain|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
The '''Onderonian resistance''' was an underground resistance movement against the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] formed by [[Vaklu]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|You mean when the Jedi entered the War."<br />"Such a view could be considered treason.|[[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]] and Captain [[Bostuco]] sharing their views on the Onderonian Resistance|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />}}
[[File:Vakluandtroops.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Vaklu]], leader of the resistance.]]
When the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] had gained control over [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], a resistance was formed to end the control of Mandalorians on Onderon, the resistance had little effect until the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] entered the war and defeated the Mandalorians, liberating Onderon from Mandalorian control. [[Vaklu]], commander-in-chief of the [[Onderonian military]], led the resistance. Despite the minority of the resistance, the act of Vaklu leading the resistance made him a war hero, making many Onderonians support him.

{{GameLS|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords}}
During the Jedi Civil War the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] went to Onderon and saw a civilian who claimed to be in the Onderonian resistance, but was falsely charged of being a Republic spy by [[Vaklu officer]]s. The Jedi Exile vindicated him, however.

==Behind the scenes==
It was possible for the Jedi Exile to not get involved and let the civilian be taken away by Vaklu officers.
